evidence_quote: This paper provides a brief road map showing the path to an energy efficient production environment
In table 1 a list of frequently used EnPIs in the manufacturing companies is provided

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Conference paper presenting an energy-management concept, an implementation roadmap, and the TIEM software tool for ISO 50001. EnPIs appear only as a borrowed reference list (Table 1, cited from [11]) of frequently-used indicator names; the paper does not construct, characterise, apply, evaluate, or critique any EnPI/EnB measurement model (no functional form, variables, or estimation approach given). Incidental EnPI mention plus tool/software focus.

paper_type.evidence_quote: the goal here is to develop a completely automated totally integrated energy management (TIEM) solution

stage1.notes: Borderline eligibility: Table 1 lists intensity-type EnPI names but the paper neither derives nor applies any of them (formula column absent from extracted text); core contribution is the TIEM software plus an EnMS/green-production concept. Context is German manufacturing/assembly (discrete), not a continuous-process sector, so not Level 3B regardless.
